fields.description: This is a TEST message from the Department of Telecommunications with NDMA, testing the Pan-India Emergency Alert System by cell broadcast. There is no emergency and no hazard.
fields.headline: TEST: Pan-India Emergency Alert System test by DoT and NDMA
fields.instruction: No action is needed. Please ignore this test message.
left_out: Specific test areas, dates and times: the target area is described only as test areas chosen by DoT, so no place names or times were added.
fields.note_for_reviewer: No hazard exists, so severity is set to Minor and urgency and certainty to Unknown. Please confirm these values meet DoT/NDMA practice for test messages. Also check whether the message should be issued in Hindi and regional languages as well as English.
